designBoundary: Frozen after source/import and discovery-identity inspection, before native execution outcome inspection. Retrospective fixed-reference facets require actual historical source applicability; no invented prospective activation.
goal: Verify actual file write/readback and arithmetic execution by the small Copilot smoke workflow; retain full original-haiku and imported acceptance separately.
population: Distinct retained smoke-copilot-small run attempts whose original source requires the same file path, three-line readback and Bash arithmetic; issue markers and related identities are discovery only.
primary: Count run attempts with protected typed successful Bash execution of echo $((6 * 7)) and native output exactly 42.
fileFacet: Count attempts with protected successful cat readback of /tmp/smoke-copilot-small-RUN_ID.txt containing exactly three nonempty lines. A successful write to that exact path must be retained separately to prove write-plus-readback.
acceptance: Do not infer tool execution from agent prose, issue PASS, source text, a green run or a known answer.
Join immutable run repository ID, workflow path, attempt, head revision and original source to protected producer execution receipts; preserve each era.

Read structured tool-call start/completion records, require matched IDs, native successful execution status and exact command/output. Reject unrelated tools, errors, quoted prose, mismatched run paths and conflicting completions.
Three-line readback is a narrow file-shape facet, not originality, haiku quality, software-testing relevance, provider identity or full workflow success.

Full acceptance additionally requires original testing haiku, actual write/readback, actual arithmetic, small-alias provider/model resolution and contemporaneously applicable imports including Playwright JS title equality, browser closure and session artifact verification.
Positive observed facets remain established when broader safeguards or coverage are unknown. Unknown history and uninspected attempts are null, not zero.

temporal.timestamp: Retained producer execution completion timestamp, never issue creation or acquisition time.
temporal.boundaries: Inclusive start, exclusive end; count each run/attempt once.
temporal.comparison: Partial retained cohorts do not establish complete comparable weekly coverage.

classification: Attainment-only unless actual symmetric pre-adoption evidence is established; smoke capability predates this workflow, historical evidence availability is separate.
